description:
Pyryze Security is a reactive, open-source Java security library that provides modular, extensible, and production-oriented cryptographic APIs for modern applications. It is designed to simplify secure system development by offering flexible abstractions for encryption, decryption, digital signatures, key management, and advanced cryptographic workflows.
Built with extensibility in mind, Pyryze Security allows new security APIs and cryptographic modules to be integrated over time without disrupting existing implementations. Its architecture supports both classical and post-quantum cryptography, making it suitable for current and future security needs.
